translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes year after year were its correspondence.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏十一年二月，江東地仍震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year of Chiwu of Sun Quan of Wu, the lands east of the river still shook.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year of Chiwu under Sun Quan of Wu, the lands east of the Yangzi still shook.

sentences.zh: 是時權聽讒，尋黜朱據，廢太子。

translations.literal: At that time Quan heeded slander, soon dismissed Zhu Ju, and deposed the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Sun Quan heeded slander, soon dismissed Zhu Ju, and deposed the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 蜀劉禪炎興元年，蜀地震。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanying of Liu Shan of Shu, Shu shook.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanying under Liu Shan of Shu, Shu shook.

sentences.zh: 時宦人黃皓專權。

translations.literal: At that time the eunuch Huang Hao monopolized power.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the eunuch Huang Hao held exclusive power.

sentences.zh: 按司馬彪說，奄宦無陽施，猶婦人也。

translations.literal: According to Sima Biao's explanation, palace eunuchs have no yang influence to bestow—they are like women.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Biao explained that palace eunuchs exert no yang influence, being like women.

sentences.zh: 此皓見任之應，與漢和帝時同事也。

translations.literal: This was the correspondence of Hao's being entrusted with office—the same affair as in the time of Emperor He of Han.
translations.idiomatic: This was the correspondence of Hao's rise to power, the same pattern as under Emperor He of Han.

sentences.zh: 是冬蜀亡。

translations.literal: That winter Shu perished.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Shu fell.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始五年四月辛酉，地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the fourth month of the fifth year of Taishi of Emperor Wu of Jin, the earth shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou of the fourth month of the fifth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu of Jin, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，新平氐、羌叛。

translations.literal: That winter the Di and Qiang of Xinping rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Di and Qiang of Xinping rebelled.

sentences.zh: 明年，孫晧大遣眾入渦口。

translations.literal: The following year Sun Hao sent a great host into Wokou.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Sun Hao sent a great army into Wokou.

sentences.zh: 叛虜寇秦、涼，刺史胡烈、蘇愉並為所害。

translations.literal: Rebel barbarians raided Qin and Liang; the inspectors Hu Lie and Su Yu were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel tribes raided Qin and Liang, and the inspectors Hu Lie and Su Yu were both slain.

sentences.zh: 泰始七年六月丙申，地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the sixth month of the seventh year of Taishi, the earth shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen of the sixth month of the seventh year of Taishi, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 武帝世，始於賈充，終於楊駿，阿黨昧利，苟專權寵，終喪天下，由是也。

translations.literal: Throughout the reign of Emperor Wu, beginning with Jia Chong and ending with Yang Jun, faction-mates concealed gain and grasped exclusive favor and power, in the end losing the realm—by this path.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout Emperor Wu's reign, from Jia Chong to Yang Jun, cliques pursued profit in darkness and hoarded power, until the realm was lost—by this very course.

sentences.zh: 末年所任轉敝，故亦一年六震，是其應也。

translations.literal: In his later years those appointed grew ever worse; hence there were six earthquakes in one year—this was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years his appointments grew ever worse, and so there were six earthquakes in a single year—the correspondence.

sentences.zh: 裴叔則曰：「晉德所以不比隆堯、舜者，以有賈充諸人在朝。」

translations.literal: Pei Shuzhe said: "The reason Jin virtue could not compare with the glory of Yao and Shun is that men such as Jia Chong were in court."
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shuzhe said, "Jin virtue could not rival the glory of Yao and Shun because men such as Jia Chong sat in court."

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧二年八月庚辰，河南、河東、平陽地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen of the eighth month of the second year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, Henan, Hedong, and Pingyang shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen of the eighth month of the second year of Xianning under Emperor Wu of Jin, Henan, Hedong, and Pingyang shook.

sentences.zh: 咸寧四年六月丁未，陰平、廣武地震；

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the sixth month of the fourth year of Xianning, Yinping and Guangwu shook;
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei of the sixth month of the fourth year of Xianning, Yinping and Guangwu shook;

sentences.zh: 甲子，陰平、廣武地又震。

translations.literal: on the day jiazi, Yinping and Guangwu shook again.
translations.idiomatic: on the day jiazi Yinping and Guangwu shook again.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康二年二月庚申，淮南、丹陽地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen of the second month of the second year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, Huainan and Danyang shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen of the second month of the second year of Taikang under Emperor Wu of Jin, Huainan and Danyang shook.

sentences.zh: 太康五年二月壬辰，地震。

translations.literal: On the day renchen of the second month of the fifth year of Taikang, the earth shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen of the second month of the fifth year of Taikang, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 太康六年七月己丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the seventh month of the sixth year of Taikang, the earth shook.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou of the seventh month of the sixth year of Taikang, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 太康七年七月，南安、犍為地震；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Taikang, Nan'an and Qianwei earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Taikang, Nan'an and Qianwei were shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 八月，京兆地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Jingzhao earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Jingzhao was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 太康八年五月壬子，建安地震；

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Taikang, Jian'an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Taikang, Jian'an was shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 七月，陰平地震；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Yinping earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Yinping was shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 八月，丹陽地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Danyang earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Danyang was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 太康九年正月，會稽、丹陽、吳興地震；

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year of Taikang, Kuaiji, Danyang, and Wuxing earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year of Taikang, Kuaiji, Danyang, and Wuxing were shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，長沙、南海等郡國八地震；

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the fourth month, Changsha, Nanhai, and eight other commanderies and kingdoms earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fourth month, Changsha, Nanhai, and eight other commanderies and kingdoms were shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 七月至于八月，地又四震，其三有聲如雷。

translations.literal: From the seventh month until the eighth, the earth again quaked four times; three of them had sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventh month through the eighth, the earth quaked four more times; three of them roared like thunder.

sentences.zh: 太康十年十二月己亥，丹陽地震。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the twelfth month of the tenth year of Taikang, Danyang earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the twelfth month of the tenth year of Taikang, Danyang was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太熙元年，地震。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taixi of Emperor Wu of Jin, earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taixi under Emperor Wu of Jin, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康元年十二月辛酉，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month of the first year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui of Jin, the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month of the first year of Yuankang under Emperor Hui of Jin, the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 元康四年二月，蜀郡山崩殺人；

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year of Yuankang, Shu commandery mountains collapsed and killed people;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year of Yuankang, mountains in Shu commandery collapsed and killed people;

sentences.zh: 上谷、上庸、遼東地震。

translations.literal: Shanggu, Shangyong, and Liaodong earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shanggu, Shangyong, and Liaodong were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，壽春山崩，洪水出，城壞，地墜方三十丈。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the fifth month, Shouyang mountains collapsed, floodwaters burst forth, the city was ruined, and the ground fell away thirty zhang square.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the fifth month, the mountains at Shouyang collapsed, floodwaters burst forth, the city was ruined, and a thirty-zhang-square section of ground subsided.

sentences.zh: 六月，壽春大雷震，山崩地坼，家人陷死，上庸郡亦如之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Shouyang was struck by great thunder and earthquake; mountains collapsed and the earth split open; households were swallowed and people died; Shangyong commandery was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shouyang was struck by great thunder and earthquake; mountains collapsed and the earth split open; households were swallowed and people perished; Shangyong commandery suffered the same.

sentences.zh: 八月，上谷地震，水出，殺百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Shanggu earthquake; water burst forth and killed more than a hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Shanggu was shaken by earthquake; water burst forth and killed more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 居庸地裂，廣三十六丈，長八十四丈，水出，大饑。

translations.literal: Juyong ground split open, thirty-six zhang wide and eighty-four zhang long; water burst forth; great famine.
translations.idiomatic: The ground at Juyong split open thirty-six zhang wide and eighty-four zhang long; water burst forth; and a great famine followed.

sentences.zh: 上庸四處山崩地陷，廣三十丈，長百三十丈，水出殺人。

translations.literal: At four places in Shangyong mountains collapsed and the earth sank, thirty zhang wide and one hundred thirty zhang long; water burst forth and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: At four places in Shangyong mountains collapsed and the earth sank, thirty zhang wide and one hundred thirty zhang long; water burst forth and killed people.

sentences.zh: 十月，京都地震；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the capital earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the capital was shaken by earthquake;

sentences.zh: 十一月，滎陽、襄城、汝陰、梁國、南陽地皆震；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Xingyang, Xiangcheng, Ruyin, Liang state, and Nanyang lands all quaked;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the lands of Xingyang, Xiangcheng, Ruyin, Liang, and Nanyang all quaked;

sentences.zh: 十二月，京都又震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the capital again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the capital quaked again.

sentences.zh: 是時賈后亂朝，據權專制，終至禍敗之應也。

translations.literal: At this time Empress Jia threw the court into disorder, seized power and ruled autocratically—the response that led in the end to calamitous ruin.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Empress Jia threw the court into disorder, seized power, and ruled autocratically—the omen that foretold her eventual ruin.

sentences.zh: 漢鄧太后攝政時，郡國地震。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Deng of Han held the regency, commanderies and kingdoms earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Deng of Han held the regency, commanderies and kingdoms were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 李固以為：「地，陰也，法當安靜。

translations.literal: Li Gu held that: "Earth is yin and by principle ought to be tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu held that: "Earth is yin and by principle ought to be tranquil.

sentences.zh: 今乃越陰之職，專陽之政，故應以震。

translations.literal: Now it has overstepped yin's office and monopolized yang's government; therefore it responds with quaking."
translations.idiomatic: Now it has overstepped yin's office and monopolized yang's government; therefore it responds with quaking."

sentences.zh: 」此同事也。

translations.literal: This is the same circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: This is the same circumstance.

sentences.zh: 京房易傳曰：「無德專祿，茲謂不順。

translations.literal: The Yijing Commentary of Jing Fang says: "Without virtue yet monopolizing emolument—this is called not compliant.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "Without virtue yet monopolizing emolument—this is called noncompliance.

sentences.zh: 厥震動，丘陵涌水出。

translations.literal: Its response is quaking; hills and mounds gush water forth.
translations.idiomatic: Its response is quaking; hills and mounds gush water forth.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「小人剝廬，厥妖山崩。

translations.literal: It also says: "Petty men strip the lodge; its portent is mountains collapsing.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Petty men strip the lodge; its portent is mountains collapsing.

sentences.zh: 茲謂陰乘陽，弱勝強。

translations.literal: This is called yin riding yang; the weak overcoming the strong.
translations.idiomatic: This is called yin riding yang—the weak overcoming the strong.
