translations.literal: The prognostication says: "A white rainbow is the qi of war.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication says: "A white rainbow is the qi of war.

sentences.zh: 三、四、五、六日俱出並爭，天下兵作，王立亦如其數。

translations.literal: When three, four, five, or six suns all appear and contend together, warfare rises under Heaven, and kings are enthroned in numbers to match.
translations.idiomatic: When three, four, five, or six suns rise together and contend, war engulfs the realm, and as many kings are enthroned as there are suns.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「三日並出，不過三旬，諸侯爭為帝。

translations.literal: " It also says: "When three suns appear together, within thirty days feudal lords contend to become emperor.
translations.idiomatic: " It also says: "When three suns appear together, within thirty days feudal lords contend to become emperor.

sentences.zh: 日重暈，天下有立王。

translations.literal: When the sun bears a double halo, under Heaven a king is enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun bears a double halo, under Heaven a king is enthroned.

sentences.zh: 暈而珥，天下有立侯。

translations.literal: When there is a halo with ear-appendages, under Heaven a marquis is enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: When there is a halo with ear-appendages, under Heaven a marquis is enthroned.

sentences.zh: 」故陳卓曰：「當有大慶，天下其參分乎。

translations.literal: " Therefore Chen Zhuo said: "There should be a great felicity; perhaps the realm will be divided three ways.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhuo therefore said, "Great fortune is at hand; perhaps the realm will be carved three ways."

sentences.zh: 」三月而江東改元朔，胡亦改元朔，跨曹、劉疆宇。

translations.literal: " In the third month the southeast changed its reign era and new moon reckoning; the barbarians also changed their reign era and new moon reckoning, straddling the domains of Cao and Liu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the southeast proclaimed a new reign and calendar; the northern barbarians did the same, and Cao and Liu domains lay sundered between them.

sentences.zh: 於是兵連積世。

translations.literal: Thereafter warfare linked one age to the next.
translations.idiomatic: War then chained age to age without rest.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝太興四年三月癸亥，日有黑子。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Taixing under Emperor Yuan of Jin, on the guihai day, the sun bore black spots.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Taixing under Emperor Yuan of Jin, on the guihai day, the sun bore black spots.

sentences.zh: 四月辛亥，帝親錄訊囚徒。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the fourth month, the emperor personally reviewed and questioned prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the fourth month, the emperor personally reviewed and questioned prisoners.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝永昌元年十月辛卯，日有黑子。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the tenth month of the first year of Yongchang under Emperor Yuan of Jin, the sun bore black spots.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the tenth month of the first year of Yongchang under Emperor Yuan of Jin, the sun bore black spots.

sentences.zh: 晉明帝太寧元年正月己丑朔，日暈無光；

translations.literal: On the jichou new moon of the first month of the first year of Taining under Emperor Ming of Jin, the sun was haloed and without light;
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the first month of the first year of Taining under Emperor Ming of Jin, the sun was haloed and without light;

sentences.zh: 癸巳，黃霧四塞。

translations.literal: on the guisi day, yellow mist closed in on every side.
translations.idiomatic: on the guisi day, yellow mist closed in on every side.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「君道失明，臣有陰謀。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler's way loses its light; ministers harbor secret plots.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication says, "The ruler's way goes dark; ministers plot in secret."

sentences.zh: 」是時王敦陵上，卒伏其辜。

translations.literal: " At that time Wang Dun towered over the throne; in the end he suffered execution for his crime.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dun at that time towered above the throne; in the end he paid with his life.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸康元年七月，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Xiankang under Emperor Cheng of Jin, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Xiankang under Emperor Cheng of Jin, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 咸康八年正月壬申，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the first month of the eighth year of Xiankang, the sun bore black spots within it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month of the eighth year of Xiankang, on the renshen day, the sun bore black spots within it.

sentences.zh: 丙子，乃滅。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day they vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day they vanished.

sentences.zh: 晉海西公太和四年四月戊辰，日暈厚密，白虹貫日中。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Taihe under the Duke of Haixi, the sun was thickly haloed, and a white rainbow pierced through the sun's center.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Taihe under the Duke of Haixi, the sun was thickly haloed, and a white rainbow pierced through the sun's center.

sentences.zh: 太和六年三月辛未，白虹貫日，日暈五重。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Taihe, on the xinwei day, a white rainbow pierced the sun, and the sun bore halos in five layers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year of Taihe, on the xinwei day, a white rainbow pierced the sun, and the sun bore halos in five layers.

sentences.zh: 十一月，桓溫廢帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Huan Wen deposed the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Huan Wen deposed the emperor.

sentences.zh: 張重華在涼州，日暴赤如火，中有三足烏，形見分明，數旦乃止。

translations.literal: In Liang province, where Zhang Chonghua held power, the sun blazed red as fire; within it a three-legged crow appeared, its form clearly visible, and this lasted several mornings before it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang province under Zhang Chonghua, the sun blazed red as fire; a three-legged crow stood within it, plain to see, and for several mornings the omen did not fade.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝元興元年二月甲子，日暈，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanxing under Emperor An of Jin, on the jiazi day, the sun was haloed, and a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yuanxing under Emperor An of Jin, on the jiazi day, the sun was haloed, and a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 明年，桓玄篡位。

translations.literal: The next year, Huan Xuan usurped the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, Huan Xuan usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝義熙元年五月庚午，日有采珥。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the fifth month of the first year of Yixi under Emperor An of Jin, the sun bore colored ear-appendages.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the fifth month of the first year of Yixi under Emperor An of Jin, the sun bore colored ear-appendages.

sentences.zh: 義熙十一年，日在東井，有白虹十餘丈，在南干日。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yixi, while the sun was in the Well constellation, a white rainbow more than ten zhang long stood south of the sun and impinged upon it.
translations.idiomatic: While the sun stood in the Well, a white rainbow more than ten zhang long rose south of the sun and pressed against it.

sentences.zh: 依司馬彪說，則災在分野，羌亡之象也。

translations.literal: According to Sima Biao's interpretation, the calamity fell in the corresponding territorial division—an image of the Qiang's destruction.
translations.idiomatic: By Sima Biao's reading, the calamity struck the corresponding territorial division—the Qiang were doomed.

sentences.zh: 晉恭帝元熙二年正月壬辰，日暈，東西有直珥各一丈，白氣貫之交匝。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the first month of the second year of Yuanxi under Emperor Gong of Jin, the sun was haloed; to east and west there were straight ear-appendages each one zhang long, and white qi pierced through them, winding round and round.
translations.idiomatic: The sun wore a halo; straight ear-lights a zhang long stretched east and west, and white qi wound through them, crossing and recrossing.

sentences.zh: 晉孝懷帝永嘉五年三月丙申夜，月蝕既；

translations.literal: On the bingshen night of the third month of the fifth year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai of Jin, the moon was totally eclipsed;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen night of the third month of the fifth year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai of Jin, the moon was totally eclipsed;

sentences.zh: 丁酉夜，又蝕既。

translations.literal: on the dingyou night, it was totally eclipsed again.
translations.idiomatic: on the dingyou night, it was totally eclipsed again.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「月蝕既盡，夫人憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When the moon is eclipsed to completion, the consort suffers grief.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication says: "When the moon is eclipsed to completion, the consort suffers grief.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「其國貴人死。」

translations.literal: " It also says: "The state's honored persons will die."
translations.idiomatic: " It also says: "The state's honored persons will die."

sentences.zh: 安帝義熙九年十二月辛卯朔旦，月猶見東方。

translations.literal: At dawn on the xinmao new moon of the twelfth month of the ninth year of Yixi under Emperor An, the moon was still visible in the east.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the xinmao new moon, the moon still hung in the east.

sentences.zh: 按占謂之「側匿」。

translations.literal: According to prognostication, this is called "lurking concealment."
translations.idiomatic: Prognosticators call this "lurking concealment."

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉二十九年十一月己卯朔，日始出，色赤如血，外生牙，塊礨不圓。

translations.literal: On the jimao new moon of the eleventh month of the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia under Emperor Wen of Song, as the sun first rose it was red as blood, with protruding fangs on its rim, lumpy and not round.
translations.idiomatic: As the sun rose it was the color of blood, jagged at the rim, lumpy and not round.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，宮車晏駕。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year, the imperial carriage rested at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the next year, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明七年十一月，日始出四五丈，色赤如血，未沒四五丈，亦如之，至于八年春，凡三，謂日死。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Daming under Emperor Xiaowu of Song, when the sun had risen four or five zhang, it was red as blood; when it had not yet set by four or five zhang, it was likewise; this continued until the spring of the eighth year—three times in all—and people called it the sun's death.
translations.idiomatic: When it had climbed four or five zhang the sun was blood-red; four or five zhang before setting it was the same. Until spring of the eighth year this happened three times, and people said the sun was dying.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，帝崩。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽三年三月乙亥，日未沒數丈，日色紫赤無光。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the third month of the third year of Yuanhui under the Later Deposed Emperor, when the sun had not yet set by several zhang, its color was purple-red and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Several zhang before sunset the sun turned purple-red and lightless.

sentences.zh: 元徽五年三月庚寅，日暈五重，又重生二直，一抱一背。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the third month of the fifth year of Yuanhui, the sun bore halos in five layers, and there grew again two straight appendages, one embracing and one at its back.
translations.idiomatic: The sun wore five halos, and two straight lights grew anew—one embracing it, one at its back.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉中，有兩白虹見宣陽門外。

translations.literal: During Yuanjia under Emperor Wen, two white rainbows appeared outside the Xuanyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanjia under Emperor Wen, two white rainbows appeared outside the Xuanyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽二年八月壬子夜，白虹見。

translations.literal: On the renzi night of the eighth month of the second year of Yuanhui under the Later Deposed Emperor, a white rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi night of the eighth month of the second year of Yuanhui under the Later Deposed Emperor, a white rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 元徽四年正月己酉，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the first month of the fourth year of Yuanhui, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the first month of the fourth year of Yuanhui, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 從帝昇明元年九月乙未夜，白虹見東方。

translations.literal: On the night of the yiwei day of the ninth month of the first year of Shengming under the Deposed Emperor, a white rainbow appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the yiwei day in the ninth month of the first year of Shengming under the Deposed Emperor, a white rainbow was seen in the east.
